quest.title: Thus Was the Work Done in Vain
quest.description: By chance, you discover notes left by an adventurer who was left stranded by Minacious Isle's traps. However, all that seems to have happened well in the now-unchangeable past. Might there be some way to help him, even if only in a Mirage?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Talk to Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Sweet Madame really is delicious.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon really gets why this Wolfgang guy misses it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Poor guy, trapped in here without any chance of having Sweet Madame just one last time...

choices.text: This notebook is very, very old...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah, but... Do you remember how we crossed through something like a lake on an island to reach another island on the other side, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The buildings on the island inside the lake do look way more complete than the ones outside it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The buildings on the current island look like ruins in comparison...

choices.text: The buildings within the lake might be...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's very likely! The buildings on the island inside might just be the original form of the ruins outside!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, do you think...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That the island within the lake is the island as it once looked?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Also, look... We can save this guy if we find where that secret chamber used to be, can't we?

choices.text: It's only gonna work within the confines of the Mirage...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, but... Even if it's all fake, and this adventurer doesn't even exist... Shouldn't we at least try to save him? His fate was so sad...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}...

choices.text: Well yes, I suppose you're right.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe! Paimon knew you'd agree, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's have a look at the island that's inside the lake.

choices.text: Let's go have a look, then...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, let's try to save this Wolfgang guy, shall we?

choices.text: That won't change what happened in reality...
The buildings within the lake reflect their original appearance...
This happened a long time ago, Paimon...

talks.objective: Go to the island within the lake to check the ruins of the past
Go to the island within the lake to check the ruins of the past
Go to the place on the lake island where the notes were left
Find a way to open the secret chamber

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's leave a few words here, he should be able to see 'em!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go back to the island outside the lake. Maybe the notes might already be gone!

talks.objective: Talk to Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The door opened! Whew, that was kinda tricky.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh, looks like Wolfgang hasn't written any notes here yet, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So he hasn't been here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We did open the chamber for him back then... This means he won't get stuck now, right?

choices.text: Well, if that device can be triggered multiple times...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, then... Um, why don't we leave him a message?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's try etching our message into someplace obvious. We'll tell him how to decipher the mechanism!

choices.text: Even if we did solve it once...

talks.objective: Etch hints for Wolfgang
Return to the outside of the lake to check Wolfgang's notes
Return to the outside of the lake to check Wolfgang's notes
Check Wolfgang's notes
Talk to Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it looks like he got out of that secret chamber after all! ... And he... credited his sharp eyes for his escape!? C'mon, we left the clue in such an obvious spot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, how many notebooks does this guy carry around!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* He didn't go back after getting out of that chamber. He actually wants to continue adventuring...

choices.text: Well, it's because he believes he resolved the crisis.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's... That's true. The secret chamber that would trap him forever has now become an obstacle that he easily overcame...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That said, the mountain ruins that he mentioned can't be seen in the island outside the lake at all.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's been a really long time since, Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did it collapse and then fall into the sea, then? Paimon's pretty sure that we saw some similar buildings outside in the ocean...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's explore the nearby sea regions when we've got the time!

choices.text: He did escape the secret chamber, you know.

talks.objective: Go to the ruins on the ocean surface to search for traces of Wolfgang
Talk to Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This notebook... Oh, it's "Wolfgang."

choices.text: Oh, joy. Stuck again, is he?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: I guess some people need some punishment before they'll learn anything...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #These underwater buildings... They should be the mountain ruins that we saw on the island on the other side of the lake. Let's go inside again to make sure, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: Didn't learn his lesson, I suppose?

talks.objective: Go to the place on the lake island where the notes were left

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place should be eye-catching enough!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's hope Wolfgang does see it, and doesn't go running around the secret chambers in these ruins anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go back and have a look. Maybe his notes might have changed this time, too!

talks.objective: Go to the place on the lake island where the notes were left
Find a way to escape the secret chamber
Talk to Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wolfgang hasn't left his notebook here either. Looks like he hasn't arrived yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's leave him some hints on how to open this secret chamber again, shall we?

choices.text: This solution...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, that's true. If Wolfgang can't make use of the elements...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then the solution's useless to him. What should we do...

choices.text: How about we just make him not enter this place at all?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, that's right! We can just leave a hint outside saying that there's a secret chamber here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then he won't come in, and he won't get trapped in these ruins!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, let's do it, quick!

choices.text: Let's leave a message outside the door.
Without the use of elemental powers...

talks.objective: Look for a place to leave hints
Return to the outside of the lake to check Wolfgang's notes

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What the... This guy's saying some pretty glib stuff, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is bad. We've got to get to Dragonspine and...

choices.text: Paimon, what we change in the Mirage will not change the past...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah... Right, that's true. Wolfgang is only "here" at all because the Golden Apple Archipelago is under the effects of that device...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's why Paimon thought that he was rescued... But in the end, he really was just stuck in that very first secret chamber, wasn't he...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But still, this Wolfgang is really... annoying! We helped him so much, but he still thinks that it would be nice if he could "pave the way" for others...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Couldn't he at least value his life a little more?

choices.text: Everybody's looking for that something...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... Paimon gets it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, if only they could have come to better ends. You know, like returning to Mondstadt, becoming great adventurers, maybe going to the tavern to play with cats, eat Sweet Madame to their heart's content...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why doesn't it ever end well for them?

choices.text: Well, it's only because people like him exist...
Wolfgang will never make it to Dragonspine...

talks.objective: Check Wolfgang's notes
Talk to Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, he didn't go in again. That's a relief.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, his annoyingly arrogant attitude is really ticking Paimon off!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He really does sound like he's getting more and more full of himself...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That said, the highland ruins he mentioned should be near the submerged ruins...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go have a look. Honestly, who knows if he was able to climb that high up safely...

talks.objective: Go to the now-sunken highland ruins

dialogues.speaker: Etchings
dialogues.text: (These etchings are old. They have been written as such...)

dialogues.speaker: Etchings
dialogues.text: "The wind is very strong here, so I'm not going to use a notebook."

dialogues.speaker: Etchings
dialogues.text: "The sunrise here is beautiful indeed. It fills my heart with satisfaction to have braved many dangers to get here."

dialogues.speaker: Etchings
dialogues.text: "I wonder if anyone will come after me to see these same sights."

dialogues.speaker: Etchings
dialogues.text: "Now that I've cleared this particular trial... Next stop, Dragonspine!"

dialogues.speaker: Etchings
dialogues.text: "This truly is a lovely place. The only thing it's missing is some Sweet Madame..."

dialogues.speaker: Etchings
dialogues.text: "Wolfgang."

talks.objective: Talk to Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, so there weren't any notes here because he carved a message on the pillar. Huh, so he made it all the way here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where does his confidence come from, though... If we hadn't helped him out, he'd still be stuck in the secret chamber!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's pretty much gonna be Chilled Meat if he goes to Dragonspine!

choices.text: That's a little overboard...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? U—Um, Paimon just means that he'd be in deep trouble if he went to Dragonspine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We need to tell him not to go, and quick!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, let's leave him another message, shall we...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, that's right! Paimon thought so too... And y'know what, let's leave him some Sweet Madame this time too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe he'll start missing the warmth of Mondstadt once he's had a bite, and he'll give up on going to Dragonspine!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Sweet Madame's gonna spoil, you know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, come on, it's the thought that counts. Right?

choices.text: Well, he's going to get in trouble for sure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! Dragonspine's super cold and is filled with hilichurls... Not to mention The Great Snowboar King!

talks.objective: Go to the island within the lake to check the highland ruins
Leave hints and a Sweet Madame
Talk to Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon really hopes that Wolfgang can give that notion of going to Dragonspine a rest...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go to the ruins we were at previously once we get out through the lake. Maybe we'll find some sign of him changing his mind!

talks.objective: Go back outside the lake to check Wolfgang's etchings

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Should we really leave the message here? Shouldn't we look for a place closer to the door?

talks.objective: Go to check the etchings that Wolfgang left behind

dialogues.speaker: Old Etchings
dialogues.text: (These etchings are old. They have been written as such...)

dialogues.speaker: Old Etchings
dialogues.text: "The wind is very strong here, so I'm not going to use a notebook."

dialogues.speaker: Etchings
dialogues.text: "Haha, to think that I'd find a Sweet Madame here — and still warm, too! It's practically a miracle."

dialogues.speaker: Old Etchings
dialogues.text: "I don't know who left that Sweet Madame there or how they knew that I wanted to have some. It's all very strange... But I'm very thankful all the same."

dialogues.speaker: Old Etchings
dialogues.text: "Thank you, person who left the etchings behind! Your Sweet Madame was the best I've ever tasted."

dialogues.speaker: Old Etchings
dialogues.text: "And thank you. I do know that Dragonspine is very dangerous... and I know my limits as well. But I must go."

dialogues.speaker: Old Etchings
dialogues.text: "Who knows, a sign that says 'here be traps' might be all that shall be left of my journey to Dragonspine."

dialogues.speaker: Old Etchings
dialogues.text: "But if someone else can avoid that danger and get further than I did, that to me would be something even more precious than a Sweet Madame."

dialogues.speaker: Old Etchings
dialogues.text: "Thank you, whoever you are who left those etchings. But we adventurers exist precisely because of perils like Dragonspine."

dialogues.speaker: Old Etchings
dialogues.text: "Dearest Regards, Wolfgang."

talks.objective: Talk to Paimon
Additional

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He should have gone into the secret chamber by the time he sees this message. Paimon thinks it won't be of that much use here...

talks.objective: Additional

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's leave our message here — and a Sweet Madame too!
